channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Waymo pauses robotaxi rides on freeways after California bars its driverless vehicles, citing an 'imminent hazard'
item.description: California has barred Waymo from testing or operating driverless vehicles on state freeways, citing repeated incursions into active construction zones and an imminent public safety hazard. Waymo has paused freeway operations in its other markets and is reviewing performance.

item.title: Nvidia Q3 results FY27: Revenue more than doubles to $115.8 billion; board begins CEO search, rules out Huang's return
item.description: Nvidia reported a 103% year-on-year rise in Q3 FY27 revenue to $115.8 billion and forecast $130 billion in Q4 revenue. The results come amid Jensen Huang's resignation, with CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

item.title: End of the road for Jensen Huang? Nvidia Board Chairman Harvey Jones says no intention to rehire him as CEO
item.description: Nvidia Board Chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO. The company has hired Heidrick &amp; Struggles to find a permanent leader, while interim CEO Colette Kress oversees operations during an investigation into Huang’s departure.

item.title: Bosch mulls sale of India tech arm, TCS among suitors
item.description: More than three-fifths of Bosch's business comes from its mobility business, which includes the car part manufacturing and software services arm for carmakers.

item.title: US Polo Assn banks on India to hit $4 billion global sales in 5-8 years
item.description: With India consumer sales set to reach ₹4,000 crore this year, the American brand plans to double its local store count to 1,000, deepen its omnichannel push, and diversify beyond menswear.

item.title: Korean shipyard drowning in orders, Samsung looks for an Indian escape
item.description: Samsung Heavy Industries is looking at India as an alternative manufacturing base to accommodate overflow orders from its Korean facilities, while also tapping the country’s emerging shipbuilding ecosystem.

item.title: Apple joins a parade of technology hiccups in recent days
item.description: Apple joins a parade of technology hiccups in recent days

item.title: Deutsche Bank leaks test CEO Sewings pledge to reform
item.description: DEUTSCHE BANK-MEDIA/SEWING (ANALYSIS, PIX):ANALYSIS-Deutsche Bank leaks test CEO Sewing's pledge to reform

item.title: OpenAI Unveils New Astra AI Model After Scrapping Prior Release
item.description: OpenAI is releasing a new version of its most advanced Astra artificial intelligence model nearly two months after the company scrapped a prior update to establish stronger safeguards for the technology.

item.title: Nvidia hires Heidrick & Struggles to find next CEO after Jensen Huang's exit
item.description: Nvidia has appointed executive search firm Heidrick &amp; Struggles to lead its CEO hunt after Jensen Huang stepped down. The company is considering both internal and external candidates.

item.title: ₹300 crore investment: T-Series and Hungama launch FastTV to bring micro-drama in India - Deal details
item.description: T-Series and Hungama's FastTV is now available on Apple App Store, Google Play Store and web. The subscription-based platform will feature original stories, adapted from 190 countries.

item.title: Reliance lays foundation for ₹1,600-crore Campa Cola plant in Karnataka; 109-acre Vijayapura unit to create 5,000 jobs
item.description: Reliance Group will invest ₹1,600 crore to set up a Campa Cola plant on 109 acres in Karnataka's Vijayapura district. The project is expected to generate 2,000 direct and over 3,000 indirect jobs, with priority urged for families who gave up land.

item.title: 'Plenty of opportunity, but...': Satya Nadella's warning to Microsoft employees as 60,000 get buyout option
item.description: Satya Nadella says Microsoft's jobs and teams will change as AI reshapes the workplace. Here's who qualifies for the voluntary buyout offer covering 60,000 employees.

item.title: Jensen Huang breaks silence 5 days after he resigned as Nvidia CEO: Read his full statement
item.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he would be honoured to return if the board asks him to. In his first public statement since resigning, he acknowledged his mistakes and said he would cooperate with the independent investigation.

item.title: Jensen Huang says ‘would be honored’ to return as Nvidia CEO if board deems it beneficial for employees, shareholders
item.description: Jensen Huang says he would be honored to return as Nvidia CEO if the board believes it would benefit shareholders and employees. He resigned last week amid an alleged Chinese spy controversy and cited calls from employees, investors, partners, and customers urging his return.

item.title: Amazon to procure $7 billion worth of renewable energy in India by 2030
item.description: The commitment adds to $4 billion already contracted. The firm has also signed 934 MW of new power purchase agreements with ReNew, Sunsure and Waaree.

item.title: Bring Jensen Huang Back to Nvidia: 1,90,000 people, including Musk and Tim Sweeney, seek ex-CEO’s return, amid scandal
item.description: Last week, Jensen Huang resigned from Nvidia over his extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. A petition has been launched, demanding his comeback.

item.title: Gurugram-based Graviton trading firm puts two founders in billionaire club as Singapore unit profits soar 166%
item.description: Graviton was valued at $1.46 billion based on the financial statements of its Indian parent and Singapore subsidiary for the year ended March 2025, according to Bloomberg.

item.title: Fairfax to sell entire 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance via block deal
item.description: FIH Mauritius Investments Ltd, an affiliate of Fairfax India Holdings Corp, is offering up to 56.53 million shares of the shadow lender at a floor price of ₹611 apiece. The deal could fetch as much as ₹3,454 crore.

item.title: Who is Aman Gupta? Shark Tank India judge joins Ranveer Singh to launch men’s grooming brand HIM
item.description: Aman Gupta, best known as the co-founder of boAt and a judge on Shark Tank India, has joined Ranveer Singh to launch HIM, a men's grooming brand. The company has entered the market with eight products priced between ₹299 and ₹899.

item.title: New Zealand's new six-month graduate work visa: Who qualifies and how to apply? Key eligibility rules explained
item.description: The new visa creates an additional employment option for international graduates who do not qualify for New Zealand's existing Post-Study Work Visa, giving them a limited period to enter the workforce and explore longer-term employment opportunities.

item.title: Tata trustees had unanimously agreed to begin the hunt for Chandrasekaran’s successor in August, Khambata reveals
item.description: Former Tata Trusts trustee Darius Khambata says every trustee, including his critics Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh, agreed on 13 August to look for Chandrasekaran’s successor. His 17 November letter questions the later decision to give Chandrasekaran a third term, which Noel Tata opposes.

item.title: Rasna wins NCLT approval to withdraw insolvency process following settlement with Bharat Road Carrier: Report
item.description: NCLT Ahmedabad Bench allowed Rasna Private Limited to withdraw its insolvency proceedings after the beverage concentrate maker settled a dispute with operational creditor Bharat Road Carrier Private Limited. The proceedings began in 2023 over unpaid transportation charges of around ₹71.27 lakh.

item.title: Vedanta steps up critical minerals hunt, bets on technology to unlock difficult-to-extract resources
item.description: Vedanta's strategy is to enter areas where the complexity of extraction and processing has kept other companies away, rather than compete only in established metals businesses.

item.title: Who is Suzanne Nora Johnson? Goldman Sachs veteran to lead Nvidia’s new national security committee
item.description: Nvidia has appointed Goldman Sachs veteran Suzanne Nora Johnson to chair its new National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee. The panel will monitor national security policies and export compliance as US restrictions on advanced AI chip exports to China face growing scrutiny.

item.title: Nvidia flags legal risks for chip buyers over China's access to AI chips via overseas data centres: Report
item.description: Nvidia reportedly had warned buyers that the proposed Remote Access Security Act (RASA) would give the US government broader powers to regulate access to cloud services, similar to physical hardware exports.

item.title: Amazon's $7 billion green energy India investment: 4 projects, 3 states, 934 MW capacity and power for 3.5 million homes
item.description: The latest commitment comes on top of the $4 billion the e-commerce major has already contracted in renewable energy investments in India, positioning it among the country's leading corporate purchasers of carbon-free electricity.

item.title: Zero delivery fees on orders above ₹49, big discounts, Bistro: Zomato steps up competition with low-cost Toing, Ownly
item.description: Zomato is increasing discounts and offering free delivery to compete with lower-cost food delivery services such as Swiggy’s Toing and Rapido’s Ownly. While these platforms appeal to customers placing smaller, budget-conscious orders, Zomato and Swiggy remain more competitive for larger orders.

item.title: Who is Lakshmi Venu and why is she seeking formal partition of TVS Venu Srinivasan family assets?
item.description: The TVS family succession dispute has escalated after Lakshmi Venu formally requested a partition of her branch’s assets, including interests in several group companies. She says she is entitled to an equal share under inheritance law and alleges her rights were overlooked.

item.title: Hotel companies hold up despite a seasonal lull
item.description: Domestic holidays, weddings and corporate events are keeping hotel rooms occupied, even as expensive airfares and geopolitical tensions weigh on some travel markets.

item.title: Know Nvidia: How ‘next version’ became Jensen Huang’s AI giant and what green colour of chipmaker’s logo signifies
item.description: Nvidia’s name combines the founders’ file label NV, meaning next version, with ‘invidia’, Latin for envy. The company nearly went bankrupt after its first chip failed, but a $5 million payment from Sega helped it recover. Its GPUs now power gaming, crypto mining and AI.

item.title: BSNL's losses widen in Q2 as revenue slips, 4G rollout pushes up costs
item.description: BSNL's consolidated net loss widened to ₹1,532 crore in the September quarter, compared with ₹1,106 crore a year earlier and ₹1,280 crore in the preceding quarter.

item.title: Who is Vidit Aatrey? Meet Meesho CEO who bought ₹83.8 cr Bengaluru villa plots from Byju Raveendran’s family
item.description: Meesho co-founder and CEO Vidit Aatrey has bought two adjoining luxury villa plots in Bengaluru’s Epsilon Residential Villas for ₹83.81 crore. The 33,485-square-foot properties were sold by family members of BYJU’s co-founder Byju Raveendran.

item.title: Who is Kunal Bahl? Meet ex-Microsoft employee whose H-1B visa rejection led him to co-found Snapdeal, Titan Capital
item.description: An H-1B visa rejection while working at Microsoft in the US prompted Kunal Bahl to return to India. He went on to co-found Snapdeal, establish investment firm Titan Capital and back hundreds of startups, becoming a prominent figure in the country's entrepreneurial ecosystem.

item.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 bn in Berkshire Hathaway shares as Thanksgiving gift, Gates Foundation misses out again
item.description: Warren Buffett will donate about $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charities associated with his children. The 96-year-old plans to give away all his shares by 2034 and said he trusts his children to direct the grants. He retains about 13% of Berkshire.
